Local SEO for auto repair shops

Catch the “mechanic near me” calls going to the shop down the road — see where you rank across every street a driver reaches you from.

Start with 10 free scans

Catch the calls going to the shop down the road

A driver with a dead battery or a grinding brake doesn’t scroll — they call one of the first shops on the map and that’s the job. Every “mechanic near me” that ranks a competitor ahead of you is a tow-in you’ll never hear about, and a single rank number can’t show you where it’s slipping. Eagle Eye maps your rank across the whole radius drivers reach you from and names the shop winning the calls you’re losing, street by street.

See where you’re losing the job

  • Rank across your draw radius — set the grid to the distance drivers come from: square, circle, or drawn to your area.
  • A competitor map per rival — the shops taking the urgent searches on the roads you don’t own.
  • ATRP — one number for the stretches where you’re off the map entirely, so the gaps are measured, not guessed.
  • Instant alerts — hear it the moment you drop out of the top 20 on a route that feeds you work.

Start free with 10 scans and a free first scan of your own shop up to 21 × 21 — credits never expire, so a slow month is never wasted. Put it on a schedule or see the plans.
